text:
Rhea: Heads-up - Maize POC reporting intermittent slow first-token after a short spike run (~08:20 PT). p50 jumped from ~170ms to 600-1.1s.
Omar: hosted trial? any special tuning?
Rhea: yes hosted. They enabled prefill per quickstart.
diag-bot: runtime v2.13.2 in us-east-1 deployed 08:05 PT, no infra alerts.
June: share their prefill config and concurrency. small batch windows + concurrency often cause KV write/read races.
Rhea: they sent: `prefill: true, prefill_batch_window_ms: 200, max_prefill_tokens: 512`, concurrency ~12, model redwood-2-8b-quant, avg prompt 130 tokens.
Kai: did they see 429s?
Rhea: brief 429 spike during the test, then later TTFT spikes.
Omar: ask for diag: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/diag/session/<sid>?fields=queue,kvcache,rate`
Rhea: returned snippet: `queue_wait_ms=365, kvcache_miss=true, backend_ms=82, x-ratelimit-remaining=78`.
June: kvcache_miss=true + high queue_wait => prefill KV thrash. Recommend quick options: 1) temp disable prefill to verify baseline, 2) increase prefill_batch_window_ms to 800-1000ms, 3) enable prefill_strict_sequencing for session-level serialization.
Lara: customer asks about credits for POC instability. Sales ops approval needed.
Omar: run short experiment: disable prefill and replay the load for 3-5 minutes. If p50 recovers, we proceed with controlled re-enable with larger window while we monitor.
Rhea: customer did quick disable -> p50 ~210ms, no 429s in 5 min.
June: confirms prefill interaction. Provide API patch snippet in email for re-enable with 1000ms window. Include diag curl and ask them to capture `x-ratelimit-*` headers if errors recur.
Omar: ops note: ticket #8390 updated: "Prefill disabled temporarily; p50 improved to ~210ms. Controlled re-enable scheduled with team watch."
Lara: I'll draft conditional one-day credit offer if instability persists after our guided change.
Kai: follow-ups: [monitor kvcache hit-rate during re-enable, capture per-shard queue_wait_ms, verify no 429s and record x-ratelimit headers].
Rhea: scheduling re-enable TOM 09:00 PT with on-call watch. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Omar: will bring KV metrics and a quick rollback command.
June: paste the exact API snippet in the ticket to make it easy for the customer.
Rhea: closing loop; will post a short postmortem after the re-enable.
